admission.justification: Two readings were considered and the authority chose the removal; the ruling constrains later memory not to re-dress the kit as a boundary.

alternatives.option: Keep the A8 publication-time kit refusal and record the kit as verified data.
alternatives.reconsider_when: If an authority reintroduces a publication-time kit check and rules the kit a boundary again.

alternatives.option: Record the kit as the presenter's offline toolbox with no refusal after carry, and the page sandbox as the boundary.
alternatives.reason: This is the ruling and what the code at 96c6b4aa does.

consequences: Later memory must not describe a kit refusal, a kit verification at publication, or the kit as a containment boundary.
DEC-6J7MCM is superseded; its refusal is history from A8, not current behaviour.
context: Amendment 81a2274c removes the publication-time kit refusal that A8 introduced and that DEC-6J7MCM recorded. The code at 96c6b4aa carries kit files under the manifest's contract path when an attempt is authored and refuses no kit path afterwards; a presenter may publish its own bytes there.
